name: OMathAutoCorrect
description: Represents the math AutoCorrect feature in Microsoft Word. To access the math AutoCorrect entries, use the OMathAutoCorrectEntries collection.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the add-in was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified OMathAutoCorrect object.

properties.name: ReplaceText
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents whether Microsoft Word automatically replaces strings in equations with the corresponding math AutoCorrect definitions. Read/write.

properties.name: UseOutsideOMath
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents whether Microsoft Word uses math autocorrect rules outside equations in a document. Read/write.

properties.name: Entries
properties.description: Returns an OMathAutoCorrectEntries collection that represents the collection of equation autocorrect entries within the equation autocorrect feature. Read-only.

properties.name: Functions
properties.description: Returns an OMathRecognizedFunctions collection that represents the recognized functions that are automatically corrected using the equation autocorrect feature. Read-only.
